view: Great Zimbabwe Great Enclosure narrow curved passage seen at eye level between two very high gently curving dry-stone granite walls, precise small coursed blocks no mortar, open sky and small grass tufts, no roof arches or European masonry, no invented carvings.

eras.title: Between the stone walls
eras.caption: A narrow passage curves between the dry-stone walls of Great Zimbabwe's Great Enclosure. Shona builders fitted granite blocks without mortar, creating a royal centre whose surviving walls still shape how people move through it.
